findings.passage: Yes, we should regulate firearms. I supported the bills which would require training and require secure firearms in cars/vehicles. Firearms are the second leading cause of death in children (1-17 years old), 71% of gun deaths are suicides, and over 900 people were killed in 2024 in Washington. Other states have shown that the higher the number of guns the more likely there will be mass shootings and violent deaths will be from guns. So, yes, I for gun regulation.
findings.note: Her written answer to question 8 of the Olympia Indivisible LD22 candidate questionnaire, asked whether more laws on sale or ownership of firearms should pass. She says yes and names support for bills on training and on secure storage of guns in vehicles. Exact date not shown on the document; 2026 inferred from the race.
